# Presentation model captures

Five sources freeze deck declarations, repeated size/dimension merging, explicit
slides, positioned boxes, nested text properties, appearance, metadata, typed
image/table/chart boxes, loose slide content and Lua constructors. Each source
and independent model capture has a content hash. Specification examples also
have independently compared models.

These are model captures. Output and PowerPoint review remain separate. Named
layouts/slots are explicitly rejected until their language and resolution rules
are introduced. Invalid signatures, content mixtures, missing dimensions and
empty-body warnings have focused tests.
